hero.description: From agriculture to catering, from public works to commerce — FICHE offers integrated services with quality and commitment for businesses and individuals in Angola.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Integrated solutions for all your business needs in Angola

agriculture.title: Agricultural Products
agriculture.description: Seeds, fertilizers, equipment and inputs for Angolan farms. Partnership with certified suppliers.
agriculture.fullDescription: FICHE offers a complete range of agricultural products to support rural production in Angola. We work with high-quality seeds, organic and chemical fertilizers, modern irrigation equipment and agricultural machinery. Our network of certified suppliers ensures reliable products for Angolan farmers.

catering.title: Catering
catering.description: Catering and restaurant services for corporate events, weddings and daily operations.
catering.fullDescription: Our catering service covers everything from small corporate events to large celebrations. With a team of experienced chefs and fresh locally-sourced ingredients, we guarantee an authentic gastronomic experience with Angolan and international flavors.

publicWorks.title: Public Works
publicWorks.description: Civil construction, infrastructure rehabilitation and engineering services throughout the country.
publicWorks.fullDescription: FICHE's public works division executes civil construction projects, road rehabilitation, bridges and urban infrastructure. We have qualified engineers, modern equipment and experience in small and large-scale projects throughout Angola.

trade.title: General Trade
trade.description: Distribution and sale of general consumer products — reliable partners for retailers and wholesalers.
trade.fullDescription: Our general trade division offers a wide catalog of consumer products, from food items to household goods. We serve retailers, wholesalers and companies throughout the country with logistical efficiency and competitive prices.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Industrial, building and equipment maintenance services to ensure business continuity.
maintenance.fullDescription: Our specialized technicians provide preventive and corrective maintenance services for industrial facilities, commercial buildings and equipment. The operational continuity of your business is our priority.

logistics.title: Logistics
logistics.description: Efficient transport and distribution of goods in Angola with own fleet and partner network.
logistics.fullDescription: FICHE has a fleet of vehicles for cargo transport throughout Angola. With established routes between major cities and regional partners, we ensure efficient, safe and punctual deliveries to any point in the country.

about.title: About FICHE
about.subtitle: A story of dedication and growth serving Angola
about.story: Founded over 15 years ago, FICHE was born with the mission of being a trusted partner for businesses and individuals in Angola. Headquartered in Luanda with operations throughout the country, we have grown to become a reference in multiple sectors.
about.mission: Our mission is to provide high-quality integrated services that contribute to Angola's economic development and improve the quality of life of Angolans.
about.vision: To be the reference Angolan company in providing diversified services, recognized for excellence, integrity and positive community impact.
about.value1Desc: We act with honesty and transparency in all our relationships.
about.value2Desc: We always seek to exceed our clients' expectations.
about.value3Desc: We adopt new solutions to better serve Angola.
